```python
def transform(grid):
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    
    for row_idx in range(len(grid)):
        consecutive_indices = []
        i = 0
        while i < len(grid[row_idx]):
            if grid[row_idx][i] == 9:
                j = i
                while j < len(grid[row_idx]) and grid[row_idx][j] == 9:
                    consecutive_indices.append(j)
                    j += 1
                if consecutive_indices:
                    # Keep the rightmost 9, change others to 2
                    result[row_idx][consecutive_indices[-1]] = 9
                    for k in range(len(consecutive_indices) - 1):
                        result[row_idx][consecutive_indices[k]] = 2
            i = j
    
    return result
```
